#!/usr/bin/env bash
set +u; source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash; set -u
D="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)"
URDF="$(cat "$D/arm.urdf")"
SRDF="$(cat "$D/arm.srdf")"
ros2 run robot_state_publisher robot_state_publisher "$D/arm.urdf" >/tmp/mvt1_rsp.log 2>&1 &
ros2 run joint_state_publisher joint_state_publisher >/tmp/mvt1_jsp.log 2>&1 &
ros2 run moveit_ros_move_group move_group --ros-args \
  -p robot_description:="$URDF" \
  -p robot_description_semantic:="$SRDF" \
  -p use_sim_time:=false \
  --params-file "$D/kinematics.yaml" \
  --params-file "$D/ompl.yaml" >/tmp/mvt1_mg.log 2>&1 &
for _ in $(seq 1 45); do
  if ros2 service list 2>/dev/null | grep -q plan_kinematic_path; then break; fi
  sleep 1
done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Brings up robot_state_publisher, joint_state_publisher and MoveIt's
# move_group node for the 3-DOF "arm3" arm, in the background.
# Does not block and does not clean up after itself.

set +u
source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash
set -u

DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
LOGDIR="${DIR}/log"
mkdir -p "${LOGDIR}"

URDF="$(cat "${DIR}/urdf/arm3.urdf")"
SRDF="$(cat "${DIR}/srdf/arm3.srdf")"
